Initial release of the 腾讯广告妙思视频检索技能:

- 支持自然语言检索腾讯广告妙思平台的视频创意，返回标题、曝光量、时长和详情页链接
- 智能去重功能，避免重复推荐链接
- 搜索结果不足时自动扩展同义词关键词
- 自动翻页和懒加载，提升检索全面性
- 用户可查看/清空已推荐历史记录
- 需登录平台以获取完整视频详情链接

- Initial release: Quickly search Tencent Ads Muse platform for ad creative videos with natural language queries.
- Supports intelligent deduplication: automatically filters out previously recommended video links for each user.
- Implements smart keyword expansion: expands similar terms when not enough results are found.
- Automatically paginates and loads more content if initial search yields insufficient results.
- Returns up to 10 results with video title, exposure, duration, and detail page link.
- Includes tools to view or clear deduplication records and browse synonym expansions.
- Requires login to access full video detail links; uses currently logged-in browser session.
